show prints one issue: its fields, its derived status, the branches that
differ from trunk on it, who has claimed it, where it sits in its epic, and the
attachments and comments that live in its folder.

The body is printed verbatim. v1.0.0 does not render markdown — glamour arrives
with the TUI.

Usage:
  isu show <id> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for show

Global Flags:
      --fetch         update remote refs before reading
      --json          print newline-delimited JSON instead of text
      --no-color      never colour the output
      --ref string    the ref isu treats as trunk (default: main, else master, else HEAD)
      --repo string   the repository to read (default: the working directory)
